title: GURPS Magic
label: GURPS Magic

exclude.reason: one record per capacity; capacity belongs on the item (sargas79/GWorldVTT#190)
kept by hand: the data file writes their energy with a thousands separator, which the parser misreads (sargas79/GWorldVTT#191)

notes: GCA cites this book as M23, and a spell the Basic Set also prints as M23, B243; those 100 are left to the system's pack. PDF page = book page + 2. The parsers do not read the file's templates, so they are kept by hand. Powerstones wait on sargas79/GWorldVTT#190. See TRIAGE.md.

patch.pattern: ^(Acid Jet|Air Jet|Breathe Fire|Breathe Radiation|Breathe Steam|Flame Jet|Icy Breath|Light Jet|Lightning Stare|Mud Jet|Radiation Jet|Sand Jet|Snow Jet|Sound Jet|Spit Acid|Steam Jet|Water Jet)$
patch.reason: Regular spells that attack each turn, dodged or blocked but not parried, delivered by this module's jet behavior

patch.pattern: ^(Rain of Acid|Rain of Fire|Rain of Ice Daggers|Rain of Stones)$
patch.reason: Area spells that do damage each second to everyone in the area, delivered by this module's rain behavior
the data file lists these breaths' skills without its SK: prefix, which the parser does not read

patch.pattern: ^(Air Jet|Ball of Lightning|Breathe Radiation|Lightning Whip|Radiation Jet|Snow Jet|Water Jet)$
patch.reason: what these do is knockback, radiation, a whip wielded as a weapon or a floating ball, not dice of injury per energy; it is in the text
missile spells whose damage the data file writes as a choice or "Spec.", which does not parse; the damage is in the text
